title: IfaMods-Ai assisted-Final fantasy IX Multiplayer
author: Fun_Geologist_1323
selftext:
Hello, everyone! I’d like to introduce a mod I’ve been working on with the help of an AI (Claude, to be exact—“Opus 5.5”).

.

It lets you play Final Fantasy IX like an MMO, share the adventure together, in different languages, and is compatible with several mods (such as Moguri and Extra Equipment Menu). 

I’m a former developer, and having been assisted in the development of this mod was a great pleasure for me—and especially sharing it :) . 



Here’s the Nexus link for anyone interested: [https://www.nexusmods.com/finalfantasy9/mods/148?tab=posts](https://www.nexusmods.com/finalfantasy9/mods/148?tab=posts)



For the 3D elements—such as the crystals, the boss raid portal, the castle, and the house—I used Tripo (tagged “IA media” on Nexus), and ChatGPT generated the interior images of the castle and house.



As for the overall organization of my mod (files, code, networking, and more), Claude helped me get organized, review my code, and fix any issues. Unfortunately, I can’t say more about why I needed assistance, but it allowed me to rediscover the world of development, and I’m happy to share it with you :)
